summary.text: Gabriella Romero is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 109 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is a public defender and former Albany Common Council member.

paragraphs.text: Romero was born in Albany, New York, graduated from Shaker High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Union College in 2014 and graduated from Albany Law School.
Her career experience includes working as a public defender.
Romero served on the Albany Common Council for Ward 6 from 2022 to 2025.
She assumed office in the Assembly on January 1, 2025, succeeding Patricia Fahy.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Codes, Governmental Employees, Real Property Taxation, Social Services, and Transportation.
